issue: `_ConsoleWarningHandler.emit` reimplements `ConsoleAdapter.warning` (`console.console.print(console.format_warning(...), soft_wrap=True)`). The contract and PRD say to call `console.warning`. The deviation is justified in the assumptions ledger (Rich wraps long paths mid-message), but it reaches into the adapter's private Rich console and duplicates the marker/print logic. Simpler: give `ConsoleAdapter.warning` (or a small sibling) the `soft_wrap` behaviour and call that, so the marker stays defined in one place.
reason: deliberate, documented design deviation: the design doc's assumptions ledger records that ConsoleAdapter.warning lets Rich wrap long config paths mid-message, which breaks the single-marked-line contract this PRD exists to create. Adding soft_wrap to the shared ConsoleAdapter.warning would change wrapping for every existing caller across all tools - out of this PRD's scope. Rendered output is identical (same ' warning ' marker line), confirmed by Blake independently.
